whenToUse: Business inputs that format while typing: money, numbers, percentages, phone (E.164), IBAN, national/tax IDs.
Values that must be stored locale-free (decimal string, compact IBAN).
avoidWhen: Choosing a quantity with a drag — use Slider.
a11y: Wrap in Field; validation messages go to Field error and are announced on blur.
The caret never jumps; the raw value is submitted via a hidden input.
